inputs.text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict

output.main_topic: Ceasefire proposals and counter-conditions in the US-Israel-Iran war
subtopics: Israel's skepticism and right to pre-emptive strikes

central_relations.subject: US
central_relations.object: 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan

central_relations.subject: Iran
central_relations.object: counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty

output.narrative_frame: The report frames the ceasefire effort as complicated by demands from all sides amid escalating Middle East tensions.
opinions: Israel is sceptical of Iran's acceptance.
